items.headline: Better speech synthesis for audiobooks
items.excerpt: “Controllable text to speech” makes speech more expressive, character voices more distinct and consistent.

items.headline: The science behind TorchNeuron, Amazon’s new PyTorch backend for AWS Trainium chips
items.excerpt: Runtime optimizations and a thorough evaluation process driven by agentic AI help ensure that models written in PyTorch will execute efficiently and reliably on Trainium systems.
